mapper.select: SELECT wr.id, wr.code, wr.supplier_name, wr.approve_status, wr.invalid_status, wrd.sku_no, wr.bill_date, wrd.receive_qty, wrd.exceed_qty, wr.delivery_warehouse_name, wr.receive_user_name, wr.purchase_user_name, wrd.remark, wrd.purchase_order_detail_id FROM po_receive_detail wrd INNER JOIN po_receive wr ON wrd.main_id = wr.id AND wrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wr.is_deleted = FALSE AND wr.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}

SELECT wrd.id AS sourceDetailId, wrd.main_id AS sourceId, wr.code AS sourceCode, wrd.sku_id, wrd.sku_no, wrd.receive_qty AS totalQty, wrd.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, wr.supplier_id, wr.purchase_order_id, wr.purchase_order_code, wr.delivery_warehouse_id FROM po_receive_detail wrd LEFT JOIN po_receive wr ON wrd.main_id=wr.id AND wr.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wrd.is_deleted = FALSE AND wrd.main_id IN
#{item}

select pr.supplier_id, count(distinct pr.id) as received_count, sum(prd.receive_qty) as received_qty from po_receive pr inner join po_receive_detail prd on prd.main_id = pr.id and prd.is_deleted = false where pr.approve_status = 'approve' and pr.is_deleted = false
and pr.supplier_id in
#{item}
AND pr.bill_date >= #{dateList[0]} AND (#{dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > pr.bill_date
group by pr.supplier_id

SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, pr.code, pr.supplier_name, pr.approve_status, pr.delivery_warehouse_id AS warehouseId, pr.delivery_warehouse_name AS warehouseName, pr.create_time FROM po_receive pr LEFT JOIN po_receive_detail prd ON pr.id = prd.main_id AND prd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pr.is_deleted = FALSE AND pr.invalid_status = FALSE AND pr.approve_status = 'approve'
AND prd.sku_no = #{skuNo}
AND pr.code ILIKE concat('%', #{code}::text ,'%')
ORDER BY pr.create_time

SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, pr.code, pr.approve_status, pr.supplier_name, pr.delivery_warehouse_name, pr.subcontract_type as subcontractType FROM po_receive pr LEFT JOIN po_receive_detail prd ON pr.id = prd.main_id AND prd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pr.is_deleted = FALSE AND pr.invalid_status = FALSE AND pr.approve_status = 'approve'
${params.permissionSql}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT t.id FROM ( SELECT prdt."id", SUM(tabp.stock_in_qty) as stock_in_qty FROM po_receive_detail prdt LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pid.source_detail_id, pid.stock_in_qty FROM po_instock_detail pid INNER JOIN po_instock pik ON pik.id = pid.main_id AND pik.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pid.is_deleted = FALSE AND pik.invalid_status = FALSE ) tabp ON tabp.source_detail_id = prdt.id WHERE prdt.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY prdt."id" ) t WHERE t.id = prd."id" AND (stock_in_qty < prd.receive_qty OR stock_in_qty IS NULL) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT t.id FROM ( SELECT tab.id, array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT unnest(array_agg(tab.qc_status))),',') AS qc_status FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, prdt.id AS detailId, qc.code, CASE WHEN qc.code is null THEN 'notQc' ELSE qc.qc_status END qc_status FROM po_receive_detail prdt LEFT JOIN po_receive pr ON pr.id = prdt.main_id AND pr.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN qc_info qc ON qc.source_detail_id = prdt.id AND qc.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE prdt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pr.approve_status = 'approve' ) tab GROUP BY tab.id ) t WHERE t.id = prd."main_id" AND t.qc_status NOT ILIKE concat('%', 'notQc' ,'%') AND t.qc_status NOT ILIKE concat('%', 'draft' ,'%') AND t.qc_status NOT ILIKE concat('%', 'waitQc' ,'%') AND t.qc_status NOT ILIKE concat('%', 'cancel' ,'%') AND t.qc_status NOT ILIKE concat('%', 'waitReQc' ,'%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT t.id FROM ( SELECT tab.id, array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT unnest(array_agg(tab.qc_status))),',') AS qc_status FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, prdt.id AS detailId, qc.code, CASE WHEN qc.code is null THEN 'notQc' ELSE qc.qc_status END qc_status FROM po_receive_detail prdt LEFT JOIN po_receive pr ON pr.id = prdt.main_id AND pr.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN qc_info qc ON qc.source_detail_id = prdt.id AND qc.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE prdt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pr.approve_status = 'approve' ) tab GROUP BY tab.id ) t WHERE t.id = prd."main_id" AND (t.qc_status ILIKE concat('%', 'notQc' ,'%') OR t.qc_status ILIKE concat('%', 'draft' ,'%') OR t.qc_status ILIKE concat('%', 'waitQc' ,'%') OR t.qc_status ILIKE concat('%', 'cancel' ,'%') OR t.qc_status ILIKE concat('%', 'waitReQc' ,'%')) )
ORDER BY pr.code DESC

SELECT SUM(pid.stock_in_qty) AS stockInQty FROM po_instock_detail pid LEFT JOIN po_instock pi ON pi.id = pid.main_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pi.approve_status = 'approve' WHERE pid.is_deleted = FALSE and pi.source_id=#{sourceId} and pid.source_detail_id=#{sourceDetailId} GROUP BY pi.source_id,pid.source_detail_id
SELECT wrd.receive_qty AS receiveQty FROM po_receive_detail wrd INNER JOIN po_receive wr ON wrd.main_id = wr.id AND wrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wr.is_deleted = FALSE and wr.id=#{id} group by wrd.id

SELECT wr.id, wrd.id AS detailId, wr.approve_status AS approveStatus, wrd.receive_qty AS receiveQty FROM po_receive_detail wrd INNER JOIN po_receive wr ON wrd.main_id = wr.id AND wrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wr.is_deleted = FALSE and wr.approve_status ='approve' and wrd.in_stock_status ='0' ORDER BY wr.create_time desc, wrd.id ASC

SELECT count(*) FROM po_receive_detail wrd INNER JOIN po_receive wr ON wrd.main_id = wr.id AND wrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wr.is_deleted = FALSE and wr.approve_status ='approve' and wrd.in_stock_status ='0'

SELECT sum(wrd.receive_qty) AS receiveQty, sum(pod.purchase_qty) AS purchaseQty, sum(wrd.exceed_qty) AS giftQty, sum((case when instock.stockInQty is null then 0 else instock.stockInQty END)) stockInQty, sum((case when returnInfo.returnQty is null then 0 else returnInfo.returnQty END)) returnQty FROM po_receive_detail wrd INNER JOIN po_receive wr ON wrd.main_id = wr.id AND wrd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT join purchase_order po on po.id = wr.purchase_order_id and po.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT join purchase_order_detail pod on pod.id = wrd.purchase_order_detail_id and pod.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN (SELECT pi.source_id,pid.source_detail_id, SUM(pid.stock_in_qty) AS stockInQty FROM po_instock_detail pid LEFT JOIN po_instock pi ON pi.id = pid.main_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pi.approve_status = 'approve' WHERE pid.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY pi.source_id,pid.source_detail_id) instock ON wr.ID = instock.source_id AND wrd.ID = instock.source_detail_id left join (select qi.source_id,qi.source_detail_id,SUM(prd.return_qty) returnQty from qc_info qi inner join po_return pr on pr.source_id=qi.id and pr.is_deleted=FALSE and pr.approve_status='approve' inner join po_return_detail prd on pr.id=prd.main_id and prd.is_deleted=FALSE and prd.purchase_order_detail_id=qi.source_detail_id where qi.is_deleted=FALSE and qi.qc_status='finishQc' group by qi.source_id,qi.source_detail_id) returnInfo on returnInfo.source_id=wr.id and returnInfo.source_detail_id=wrd.purchase_order_detail_id WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and wr.is_deleted = FALSE
${params.permissionSql}

select pr.id, pr.code, pr.source_id, pr.source_type, pr.source_code, prd.id as detailId, prd.source_detail_id from po_receive pr inner join po_receive_detail prd on pr.id = prd.main_id and prd.is_deleted = false where pr.is_deleted = false and prd.id in
#{item}
